source_identity_note: The installed wheel digest, not the separately observed main branch, defines executed source identity.
normalization: Per-window single mean and population standard deviation from retained channels only; scale to std 0.1; target tokens exactly zero. Apply inverse scalar transformation from retained channels only. No additional re-reference or filter.
upstream_pipeline_difference: Uses the pinned low-level model sample API; deliberately does not use upstream per-channel normalization, automatic average reference, filtering, masking heuristics, or seam corrections. This is a PRAYCG experimental operationalization, not an exact reproduction of the published evaluation.
